snippet.title: Deadzone: Rogue – Indie World Showcase 3.3.2026
snippet.description:
Deadzone: Rogue is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on March 17, 2026! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/deadzone-rogue-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Step into a forsaken space station in Deadzone: Rogue, a fast-paced roguelite FPS where every run is a heated fight for survival. Explore shifting corridors, scavenge and combine experimental weaponry and augments, and destroy biomechanical swarms that evolve with each encounter—whether you’re venturing alone or teaming up with friends in co-op.

Can you survive long enough to conquer the Deadzone?

#IndieWorld #DeadzoneRogue #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
